PORT.description: HTTP listen port. Calnode defaults to 3000; Railway maps the public domain to this port.

BASE_URL.description: Public identity host — the URL your team and bookers use (e.g. https://book.example.com or https://<domain>.up.railway.app). Drives OAuth callbacks, admin UI, and invite links. Set your real domain after the first deploy and redeploy.

DATABASE_URL.description: SQLite driver location. SQLite is the only store (pure-Go, no CGO, no Postgres). Keep the /data path — it is on the calnode-data volume.

CALNODE_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Envelope-encryption master key (auto-generated). Required for production. Rotatable later with `calnode rotate-key`.

CALNODE_RECOVERY_SECRET.description: Optional break-glass escrow for recovering from a lost CALNODE_ENCRYPTION_KEY.

TZ.description: Timezone for meetings, reminders, logs. e.g. America/New_York.

GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID.description: Optional Google OAuth client ID. Add redirect {BASE_URL}/v1/auth/callback + {BASE_URL}/v1/calendar/callback.

MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID.description: Optional Microsoft 365 / Outlook client ID (Azure App registration).

MICROSOFT_TENANT.description: Microsoft tenant; 'common' = personal + work/school. Set a tenant ID to restrict to your org.

EMAIL_SMTP_HOST.description: Optional SMTP host for booking invitation / confirmation emails. Blank = no email.

LITESTREAM_REPLICA_URL.description: Optional S3 bucket for continuous SQLite backups (Litestream) + meeting recordings. e.g. s3://bucket/calnode. Blank = local volume only.

LITESTREAM_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: Optional S3 access key (pair with LITESTREAM_REPLICA_URL).

LITESTREAM_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.description: Optional S3 secret key (pair with LITESTREAM_REPLICA_URL).

LITESTREAM_ENDPOINT.description: Optional S3 endpoint host. Required for non-AWS providers (R2, B2, MinIO).
